sourceFacts.description:
**PRODUCT OVERVIEW**
This floral maxi skirt is made for women who want a flowing, feminine look for warm-weather days and dressy occasions. Its lightweight chiffon moves gently on a beach walk, a summer vacation or a weekend outing, keeping you comfortable all day. The elastic high waist and pleated A-line silhouette make it easy to dress up for a wedding guest outfit, a party or a dinner date. Paired with a simple tee or camisole, it also works as a practical long skirt for office and everyday wear.

**GENERAL INFORMATION**
**Department:** Women
**Item Type:** Skirt
**Age Range:** Adult
**Season:** Summer
**Occasion:** Casual, Party, Wedding, Work

**DESIGN DETAILS**
**Style:** Maxi, Pleated
**Pattern:** Floral
**Pleats:** Pleated skirt body with flowing layers

**MATERIALS & FABRIC**
**Fabric:** Chiffon
**Lining:** Soft inner lining
**Construction:** Double-layer, opaque coverage

**FIT & SILHOUETTE**
**Rise:** High rise
**Waistband:** Elastic
**Silhouette:** A-line
**Hemline:** Flared
**Length:** Floor-length maxi

**CARE INSTRUCTIONS**
**Washing:** Machine washable in cold water
**Hand Wash:** Yes, cold water
**Drying:** Hang dry to maintain pleats and smooth finish
sourceFacts.searchTerms: flowy long skirt pleated long skirts wedding guest skirt
bullets: **[FLORAL MAXI SKIRT]** Floral print maxi skirt with a floor-length A-line silhouette that swings naturally with every step. The pleated body flatters hip and leg lines for a slim, elegant look, making it a versatile long skirt for summer outings, dates and dressy events.

**[LIGHTWEIGHT CHIFFON]** Made from skin-friendly, lightweight, breathable chiffon that drapes smoothly and stays comfortable in hot weather without stuffiness. The airy fabric suits warm-day wear such as beach vacations, daytime errands and summer evenings.

**[ELASTIC HIGH WAIST]** The high-rise elastic waistband flexes to fit different waist sizes and stays in place all day. It gently slims the waistline for a relaxed, flattering fit that works for work, casual walks and party nights.

**[LINED FOR COVERAGE]** A soft inner lining prevents see-through, and the double-layer pleated construction keeps the skirt opaque when you sit, walk or move. It is suitable for casual, party, wedding and formal occasions.

**[OCCASIONS & CARE]** Pairs easily with camis, tees, shirts, sweaters or jackets for daily life, office, beach, vacation, wedding, party and dating. Machine washable in cold water; hang dry to help keep the pleats crisp and the finish smooth.
